questions.q: What does the sku block's name field control in an azurerm_fabric_capacity resource?
options: The Terraform provider version
The F-SKU (F2 through F2048) — the exact same sizing choice taught in Fabric & Real-Time Analytics Lesson 64
The Azure region the capacity is deployed to
The name of the resource group
questions.explain: Lesson 64 already taught how to choose an F-SKU by expected load; this lesson only changes how that same choice is written down.

questions.q: Why does the example use data.azurerm_client_config.current.object_id for administration_members instead of a hardcoded UPN?
options: Because administration_members only accepts data source values, never literal strings
Because it makes the capacity deploy faster
So the same file still applies correctly even after the specific person hardcoded in it would have left the team
Because hardcoded UPNs are rejected by the AzureRM provider
questions.explain: A data source grabs whichever identity is currently authenticated, rather than baking in one person's identity forever.

questions.q: What happens if a Fabric Capacity is applied with an empty administration_members list?
options: The capacity is created with F2 as the default SKU regardless of what was specified
Terraform refuses to apply the configuration
Azure automatically assigns the subscription owner as administrator
The capacity deploys but nobody has been granted a way to manage it afterward
questions.explain: administration_members is marked optional by the provider, but leaving it empty in practice creates a capacity nobody can manage.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what should you check first if an older Terraform tutorial doesn't mention azurerm_fabric_capacity at all?
options: Which azurerm provider version your required_providers block is pinned to
Whether Terraform itself needs to be reinstalled
Whether your Azure subscription supports Fabric at all
Whether you spelled the resource type correctly
questions.explain: This resource type is recent; an older tutorial or an older pinned provider version may simply predate it.

questions.q: What are the two valid formats for an entry in administration_members?
options: A Microsoft Entra user's UPN, or a service principal's object ID
A display name, or an email alias
A storage account key, or a SAS token
A subscription ID, or a resource group name
questions.explain: The provider requires UPN format for Entra users and object ID format for service principals — not display names or aliases.
